issues.title: Manufacturer communication: air bag warning / occupant classification
issues.cause: A check control message for the restraint system appears. In the instrument cluster, the red air bag warning light lights up permanently.
issues.inspection: Ask a dealer whether manufacturer communications 10214266 apply to this VIN and were performed.

issues.title: Manufacturer communication: battery drain / no start
issues.cause: NAVIGATION PRO (NBT EVO) MAP UPDATE NOT POSSIBLE, NAVIGATION DOES NOT START: Navigation system will not start at all or the: Navigation system starts message is permanently displayed; or | ENGINE DOES NOT START BELOW FREEZING TEMPERATURES: Engine designation correction Parts availability Warranty. The engine will not start at temperatures below freezing. The starter does not turn and engage.
issues.inspection: Ask a dealer whether manufacturer communications 10143565, 10170572 apply to this VIN and were performed.

issues.title: Manufacturer communication: infotainment / display
issues.cause: NBT-EVO Head Unit Cannot be Swapped between Vehicles for Testing. issues.inspection: Ask a dealer whether manufacturer communications 10135992, 10138404, 10138411, 10142940, 10142941 apply to this VIN and were performed.

issues.title: Manufacturer communication: steering column / coupler noise
issues.cause: NOISE WHEN ADJUSTING THE STEERING COLUMN UP OR DOWN: Creaking noise when raising or lowering the steering column position. CAUSE Steering column adjustment.
issues.inspection: Ask a dealer whether manufacturer communications 10170575 apply to this VIN and were performed.

issues.title: Manufacturer communication: air bag warning / occupant classification
issues.cause: A check control message for the restraint system appears. In the instrument cluster, the red air bag warning light lights up permanently. | A check control message for the restraint system appears. issues.inspection: Ask a dealer whether manufacturer communications 10212527, 10214266, 10227927 apply to this VIN and were performed.

issues.title: Manufacturer communication: infotainment / display
issues.cause: BMW CONNECTEDDRIVE APPS ARE NO LONGER AVAILABLE AFTER PROGRAMMING: After programming vehicle with "20-03" software, BMW ConnecedDrive apps are no longer available in the head unit. Software in the Head Unit High (HU-H3). | HEAD UNIT RESETS WHEN NAVIGATION IS USED IN CERTAIN LOCATIONS: The head unit resets sporadically causing the CID to turn black and then starts up again after a short time with the message "Start navigation system". This only occurs during navigation guidance when the "3D building" function is used Software in the Head Unit High (HU-H3). | HEAD UNIT RESETS WITH FAULT CODE B7F8F9 RESET WATCHDOG: Customer states the following about their vehicle: Active radio or music source is interrupted. The navigation is no longer available. A black screen is shown in the Control Display.
issues.inspection: Ask a dealer whether manufacturer communications 10179010, 10179821, 10184588, 10186230, 10186892 apply to this VIN and were performed.

issues.title: Manufacturer communication: steering column / coupler noise
issues.cause: REMOTE CONTROL IS NOT DETECTED: Vehicle cannot be opened or closed using comfort access, engine start is not possible, and the vehicle may not start when placing the key against the steering column. Note: Opening, closing and starting via the BMW Digital Key or the Digital Key Card are not affected. Software error in the BDC (Body Domain Controller) module. | FAILURE OF THE ELECTRIC STEERING COLUMN ADJUSTMENT AT HIGHER CABIN TEMPERATURE: Electric steering column adjustment fails when interior cabin temperatures rise above 122 degrees F (e.g., parked outdoors on hot day). Faulty self-diagnosis of the steering column control unit. | GROANING NOISE DURING HEIGHT ADJUSTMENT OF THE ELECTRIC STEERING COLUMN: A groaning type noise is heard during the height adjustment.
issues.inspection: Ask a dealer whether manufacturer communications 10179825, 10181219, 10181220, 10182608, 10182907 apply to this VIN and were performed.

BMW CONNECTEDDRIVE APPS ARE NO LONGER AVAILABLE AFTER PROGRAMMING: After programming vehicle with "20-03" software, BMW ConnecedDrive apps are no longer available in the head unit. Software in the Head Unit High (HU-H3).
